notes: Pricing: the snapshot captured a monthly/annual toggle but only one amount per plan: Personal $38/mo ('Only available as an annual plan'), Business $150/mo with 'Save $456/year', Agency $300/mo with 'Save $900/year'. Annual-equivalent amounts for Business/Agency are not rendered, and it is ambiguous whether $150/$300 are the monthly-billed prices or annual equivalents; the PO may want to check. Personal is annual-only, so its period is 'year' (amount displayed per month). Prices are shown with '$' only; USD assumed. The free audience preview ('Create an account and run a free audience preview first. No credit card needed') is a free trial-like preview, not a plan; pricing_status was left out (paid vs freemium is ambiguous). The SparkToro API is a separate pay-as-you-go credit product ('no subscription required'), not a plan. Integrations: only the MCP clients named on the page (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor); Google/Bing are data sources, not integrations. Fields: country US is stated ('based in Washington State, USA'); a city is not (Washington State is a state); founders are named but no founding year or headcount is stated (prior Moz careers must not be used to infer dates). Customer testimonials and figures (e.g. '27% of the average cost per lead') are customer claims, not payment proof. The FAQ line forbidding bots/scrapers is a usage policy, not an instruction aimed at the extractor.
